metricDefinitions.label: Cash benchmark comparison
metricDefinitions.definition: Joint coefficients carry a new separate global Holm243 p-value and Bonferroni243 intervals for all27 joint alphas and216 betas across three periods. Original raw243 corrections remain unchanged. Displayed alpha intervals are marginal95% normal-Wald; subtracting constant cash leaves betas and beta intervals unchanged.

evidenceFlow.title: Audited fixed-strategy cash benchmark calculation
evidenceFlow.detail: Read results/cash_excess/joint_coefficients.csv, results/cash_excess/matched_btc_coefficients.csv, results/cash_excess/btc_full_period_coefficients.csv, results/cash_excess/methods.json; filter period=validation; retain every approved strategy in fixed ID order. Computed from saved daily returns and factor inputs without new hourly prices, trading simulation or selection.

limitations: Hypothetical constant USDT cash proxy, not an actual instrument or earned strategy interest. USD interpretation assumes USDT/USD parity.
Conditional diagnostics, not adjusted for the original basket/configuration/selection research and not a new independent test.

methods.code: Read the listed saved CSV/JSON results; filter this exact period. Display-only percentage/CI rounding; do not regenerate signals, targets, trades, coefficients, bootstrap draws or strategy selections.
